Transport-aware format

A home that unfolds
in a few hours.

Delivered as a compact, closed unit. Side panels open outward to extend the floor, then expand and lock into a finished living space.

  1. Transport folded

    Delivered as a compact, closed unit for transport.

  2. Unfold panels

    Side panels open outward to extend the floor footprint.

  3. Expand and lock

    The structure is expanded and secured in position.

  4. Ready to live

    Finished home with doors, windows and configurable interiors.

X-Foldable Unit

Folds flat.
Opens into space.

The X-Fold Unit travels in a compact transport form. On site it is lifted into position and opens through an X-shaped fold, then settles into an enclosed unit with a door, sliding windows, LED lighting and durable flooring.

  • Reinforced corners
  • Strut-assisted hinge
  • Insulated wall panels
  • Durable flooring
Flat Pack

A smarter way to move a building.

Prefabricated components are delivered in a compact, palletised package and assembled at the destination. Useful where access is limited or logistics need careful planning.

  1. Compact kit delivery
  2. Prepared base frame
  3. Frame and panels
  4. Finished space
Motorised Pergola

Control the feel of the outdoors.

Motorised louvres open, tilt or close to manage sunlight, airflow and rain protection across patios, terraces and hospitality spaces.

0°
Open: maximum airflow
45°
Tilt: adjustable shade
90°
Closed: rain cover

Control options may include remote, mobile app and voice control, depending on the selected model and controller. Confirm wind rating, drainage and installation requirements for each site.

Inflatable Pool

Summer, without
permanent construction.

A portable drop-stitch pool for gardens, terraces, farmhouses and resorts. No digging or concrete work; unpack, inflate and fill on a suitable prepared surface.

Compact capacity
2,400 L
Large family capacity
10,800 L
Indicative inflation time
5–10 min
Storage
Deflates and packs away

Important: 1,000 litres of water weighs approximately one tonne. Have any terrace or balcony slab professionally checked before placing a pool above ground level. Adult supervision is essential.

Every project begins with the application and site conditions. Confirm the right structure, transport method, foundation, services and local approvals before finalising a specification.

Site and access

Structure

Climate

Services

Configuration
Layout, doors, windows, fittings, finishes and accessories
